synopsis: The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources (DMPR), formerly the Department of Mineral Resources and Energy, administers South Africa’s governing mining law, the Mine Health and Safety Act 29 of 1996 [f15553]. DMPR recorded 42 South African mining deaths in 2024, including 14 in the “transportation and mining” category—about one third of the total [f3201, f3202, f3139]. It also recorded nine TMM deaths in 2024, compared with six in 2023 [f3203]. The supplied facts do not specify how the TMM deaths overlap with the broader “transportation and mining” category [f3202, f3203].

relations.note: Both report 14 transportation and mining deaths in South Africa in 2024.
The total of 42 establishes that 14 deaths represent one third.
Provides the transportation and mining category count within the 2024 total.
